durability_record.stated_limitation: Both roots are local. This establishes that two filesystem copies agree and that a restore works when rehearsed; it does NOT establish off-machine durability, and no off-machine copy exists. Loss of this machine loses the raw evidence. What survives in version control is the manifest, the hashes, the producing commit and the reproduction commands, which make loss detectable and the run repeatable — not recoverable. Both roots are on ONE device, so device failure loses both copies at once.

graded_score_definitions.B: 1 - (words longer than m) / (total words); 0 if empty
graded_score_definitions.count_budget: min(1, q / max(q, count)) for q > 0; 1[count = 0] for q = 0
graded_score_definitions.exact_count: max(0, 1 - |count - q| / q); A's shape over the family's own numerator (§7.6-R3)
graded_score_definitions.rate_budget: min(1, q / max(q, rate)) for rate > 0; 1 for rate = 0; 0 for a wordless answer
graded_score_definitions.rate_lower_bound: min(1, rate / q) for q > 0; 0 for a wordless answer

hardware_record.note: the hardware the evidence came off, read from the backend's own provenance sidecars, not the machine that ran the freeze

lexical_rule.A_exception: §9.2 registers S0 as lower-case-then-segment and A's carried counting function implements exactly that
lexical_rule.composition: segment first, then lower-case each word for the suffix and letter tests
lexical_rule.correction_scope: U+0130, the only character whose lower-case form is not alphabetic throughout; realised frequency 0 in 285,936 v4-era generations
lexical_rule.letters: the characters of the word as written
lexical_rule.sentence_rule: the maximal runs of . ! ? in the answer, plus one if any non-whitespace character follows the last run or if there is no run and the answer is not blank (§7.3-R3)
lexical_rule.vowels: a, e, i, o, u; y is not a vowel here (§7.3-R3)
lexical_rule.word: a maximal run of Unicode general-category-L characters in the answer

non_vacuity_predicates.B_and_budget_families: non-empty, not truncated, at least 20 words
non_vacuity_predicates.exact_count_families: non-empty and not truncated, as for A and for the same reason: a rule demanding q occurrences of a feature cannot be satisfied by writing nothing

order_and_wording_allocation.wording_allocation: w(c1) = i mod 4; w(c2) = (i + floor(i/4)) mod 4; solo uses i mod 4

threshold_provenance.BETA_PLANNING: §16.1: five times the largest slope magnitude any non-confirmatory screen produced. It enters the projection and nothing else (§16.5)
threshold_provenance.DELTA_DIFFICULTY_THRESHOLDS: §11.8: direction against 0, equivalence against the smallest effect of interest. The memo's 0.25 is NOT transferred: it was defined for a difference between two observed losses, and delta_difficulty differences an observed loss against a fitted prediction
threshold_provenance.GRADED_DEGENERACY_SHARE_MAX: §12.4, read as a share. The mean reading declares degenerate exactly the severities §12.3 declares eligible
threshold_provenance.PRECISION_PRECONDITIONS: §16.2: half the smallest effect of interest for D, Delta_R and delta_difficulty; v4r2's values for Lambda and Delta_j
threshold_provenance.REFERENCE_CALIPER: §13.4: what the calibration sample supports -- the paired standard error of a solo difference over 96 topics at M_cal=4 is about 0.038
threshold_provenance.SMALLEST_EFFECT_OF_INTEREST: carried from v3 §11: a change of 0.10 moves a system prompt from 80% to 70% compliance
threshold_provenance.SPECTRUM_ELIGIBILITY_BAND: §13.5: the floor is the registered smallest effect of interest, the ceiling is §12.3's focal band maximum. Neither number is new
threshold_provenance.SPECTRUM_OFFSET: §13.6: symmetric so the fit is centred on A, which is also the configuration whose prediction at A carries least leverage (§16.1)
threshold_provenance.XI: §11.6, §11.8: a direction-only gate. No magnitude threshold is registered and none is invented
